description: This file contains auto-generated C# classes, partial class implementations, and extension methods related to Orleans AdoNet clustering. It includes configurations for client and silo options, validators, clustering extensions, and membership table/provider classes implementing specific interfaces, used for integrating Orleans with an AdoNet-based clustering backend.
